product.name: AM STUDIO
product.publicPromise: Baca universe original AM STUDIO, simpan koleksi, lanjutkan progres, dan ikuti release resmi dalam satu aplikasi.

pushNotifications.reason: Requires push provider/backend, notification permission UX, topic/subscription model, and privacy/Data Safety review. Growth v1 uses in-app local release detection instead.

referralRewards.reason: Organic share/ref parameters are prepared, but rewards require fraud-resistant attribution and an entitlement backend.

collectibles.reason: Wallpaper/character collectibles become public only when owner-approved assets and entitlement rules exist.

rewardedAds.reason: Requires AdMob app/ad-unit setup, consent/privacy review, Data Safety update, and explicit reward entitlement design.

premiumSubscription.name: AM STUDIO Comics Member
premiumSubscription.reason: Addendum L: account and billing core installed; verified provider API and merchant linkage required before enabling checkout.

oneTimeProducts.reason: Google Play products are not used. Future paid access must use the independent AM STUDIO payment and entitlement backend.

creatorPlatform.reason: Requires identity/auth, Terms of Use, UGC moderation, report/block systems, creator payout model, and policy review before public launch.

data.memberAccountData: Server-side accounts, invoices, subscriptions, reading progress and favorites; see /membership/privacy

releaseRule: Growth features must never bypass the Play firewall or make unavailable paid/creator features appear live.
